notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ عُبَيْدُ بْنُ زُرَارَةَ» names the asker; «سأله» gives the one asked only as a pronoun, so the Imam comes from prev1 (rule: previous reports, owner ruling).
prev1 (646) writes «سَأَلَ مَالِكٌ اَلْجُهَنِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»; the Imam is the last name of its chain, inherited as the last link after the asker.
The saying «إِذَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ» is the Imam's answer; no further transmitter is written.
